start.welcome:
Hello, {first_name}! 👋

Welcome to MultiSaver_bot!

Send supported media links from Instagram, Telegram, Facebook, Pinterest, Snapchat, YouTube, TikTok, and Likee.
Depending on the media type and platform capabilities, we'll help you download videos, images, or audio.

platforms.title:
📱 Supported platforms:

• YouTube — public videos and Shorts
• Instagram — public posts and Reels
• Telegram — public channels and posts
• Facebook — public videos
• Pinterest — public Pins
• Snapchat — some public content
• TikTok — public videos
• Likee — supported public videos

⚠️ Some links may not work due to platform restrictions. Private or protected content cannot be downloaded.
settings.title: ⚙️ Settings
privacy.text:
🔒 Privacy Policy

• Information necessary to operate the bot may be stored, including your Telegram ID, language preference, and download statistics.
• Media files are stored temporarily and should be deleted after the configured retention period.
• Your data is not sold to third parties.
• Survey responses may be used to improve the service.
help.text:
❓ Help

1. Send a media link from a supported platform.
2. The bot checks the link and downloads the media if possible.
3. Audio can be extracted from supported videos.
4. Change the language using /language or the menu.

Commands:
/start — Main menu
/help — Help
/language — Change language
/supported — Supported platforms
/history — Download history
/settings — Settings
/cancel — Cancel the current action

If a problem occurs, try again or send a different link.
error.generic: An error occurred. Please try again later.
